sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD15/BZ at 174-176 Ripple Road.
The record gives 9 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 0.04ha.
The record is permissioned with full-planning-permission dated 21 December 2016.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not a named proprietor/title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry rather than an exact application or HMLR polygon.
Planning Data links the record to planning-history id 14046.
At the 8 February 2016 meeting, 15/00427/FUL was deferred rather than finally approved.
On 7 March 2016 the Committee considered a retail ground floor plus 9 flats on the former Westbury Arms site.
The Board granted permission subject to completion of a Section 106 agreement securing an overdue demolition-cost payment and listed conditions.
The 21 December 2016 permission date is retained separately from the March Committee resolution and S106 condition.
The BZ site is the former Westbury Arms at the Ripple Road/King Edwards Road junction and is not merged with 194 Ripple Road or other Ripple Road cases.
No current HMLR title topology, completion status or executed statutory overlay bundle was verified this wave.

examples.result: BZ remains a current 9-home permissioned Brownfield record.
The February 2016 deferral is not treated as approval.
The March 2016 Committee resolution is kept separate from the December permission date.
The Section 106 condition is not silently assumed completed from the Committee text alone.
The nine flats are not merged with the separate 194 Ripple Road nine-flat church scheme.
The Brownfield point is not converted into an HMLR polygon.
Private/non-public ownership category is not proprietor identity.
Promotion remains zero until current title, completion and overlay evidence are verified.
